author: Lustral Team
name: Lustral Mod
description: A Unity mod project for Lustral. Building the project deploys the mod to the game.

game.description: The game to build against: the name of its installation folder in a Steam or Epic Games Launcher library (for example "BOMBANANA!"), or its full path. To target both scripting backends, use --mono-game and --il2cpp-game instead.

monoGame.description: The Mono game to build against, for mods that target both scripting backends: its installation folder name, or its full path.

il2cppGame.description: The IL2CPP game to build against, for mods that target both scripting backends: its installation folder name, or its full path.

id.description: The mod ID: lowercase letters and digits, separated by dots, hyphens or underscores (for example you.yourmod). Defaults to the project name in lowercase.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
